import os, sys, time, json
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print('SPEC', json.dumps(spec, indent=2), flush=True)
obs = r.get_obs(video='frames')
obs.save('/app/output/initial')
print('PROPRIO', obs.meta.get('proprio'), flush=True)
print('OBS SAVED /app/output/initial', flush=True)

def observe(seconds=0):
    global obs
    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video='frames')
    obs.save('/app/output/last_obs')
    print('OBS', obs.meta.get('proprio'), flush=True)
    return obs

def ee(rows):
    global obs
    result = r.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), video='both')
    result.save('/app/output/last_action')
    print('RESULT', result.meta, flush=True)
    obs = result
    return result

def joints(rows, dt=0.2):
    global obs
    result = r.submit('joint_position', np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, video='both')
    result.save('/app/output/last_action')
    print('RESULT', result.meta, flush=True)
    obs = result
    return result
